_what: RUCKUS, STANDARD (the B&B Sport Aviation 'RUCKUS - Airframe' sheet, the user 9 Nov): the Solo 103 airframe - 8.66 m, 11.33 m2, 5.33 m; open frame (no skin), no rear aero pod, the taper section carrying the boom; wing Oratex on two aluminium tube spars and formed ribs (the user's wing-internals model: the garage's "aluminium tube" wing), carbon tail and slats (automatic, full span), the flaperon nearest the garage has (plain inboard flaps + ailerons drooping 20 deg), disc toe brakes; the Polini Thor 303 from the dials on the Rotax 277 (76 x 62 mm, liquid, 38 hp, 20 kg with its radiator; 1.6 m 2-blade wood), manual start (no electrics); one 5 gal tank (19 L, a wing-root bay: the pod's nose holds 9 L).
